Who we are
The City of Salisbury is the most progressive council in South Australia, driving growth, jobs, housing and opportunity in the north. With a workforce of over 400 people, we offer the chance to collaborate with teams across the organisation to deliver meaningful, community-focused projects.
The City Infrastructure Department delivers asset management, capital works, and maintenance programs, as well as oversees lease management for local community and sporting clubs, and security and civil compliance functions.
Join us and see the positive impact your work can make.
About the role
The City of Salisbury is seeking three experienced Asset Engineers to join the Engineering Assets & Systems team within City Infrastructure. Opportunities are available across Civil, Roads and Drainage asset portfolios.
Reporting to the Divisional Head, Engineering Assets & Systems (Asset Engineer - Civil and Asset Engineer - Roads) or the Senior Stormwater Engineer (Asset Engineer - Drainage), you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving asset management plans, undertaking engineering investigations and modelling, and supporting long-term infrastructure planning and investment decisions.
You will play a key role in managing and improving some of the City's most important infrastructure assets, including roads, drainage networks, wetlands, bridges, boardwalks, coastal assets, carparks, signage and stormwater infrastructure, helping ensure they continue to meet the needs of our growing community.
Your key responsibilities will include
- Develop, maintain and improve Asset Management Plans across a range of infrastructure asset classes.
- Undertake engineering investigations, modelling, analysis and reporting to support asset management decisions.
- Develop capital renewal, maintenance and lifecycle programs.
- Assess asset condition, risk, service levels and long-term investment priorities.
- Prepare project briefs and business cases for infrastructure projects and renewal programs.
- Evaluate consultant reports, designs and technical proposals.
- Provide specialist engineering and asset management advice across the organisation.
- Support planning for future growth and infrastructure needs across the city.
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with community members, developers, government agencies, service authorities and internal stakeholders.
- Communicate technical information and asset management recommendations clearly to a diverse range of stakeholders, including residents, elected members and senior leaders.
- Respond to enquiries from residents, elected members and other stakeholders.
About you
You are a qualified engineer with experience in infrastructure asset management and a passion for delivering practical, long-term outcomes for communities. You combine strong technical capability with excellent communication skills and can confidently engage with a wide range of stakeholders. You are able to translate complex engineering and asset management information into clear, practical advice that supports informed decision-making.
You will also have
- Degree qualifications in Civil Engineering, equivalent qualifications, or proven extensive experience in asset management relating to civil infrastructure and stormwater.
- Experience in infrastructure asset management, planning and lifecycle analysis.
- Knowledge of asset management frameworks such as ISO 55000 and IIMM/IPWEA practices.
- Experience using asset management, GIS and engineering modelling systems.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Proven experience building productive relationships with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders.
- Strong written communication skills, including the preparation of reports, business cases and technical documentation.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Current driver's licence.
Desirable
- Postgraduate qualifications in asset management.
- Experience working within local government.
What we offer
- State-of-the-art Salisbury Community Hub is 25 minutes from the CBD with excellent rail and road connections.
- Modern and positive work environments.
- Free car parking.
- Flexible work options.
- Three additional leave days per year.
- Annual pay rises.
- Health and wellbeing programs, including skin checks, health assessments, flu vaccinations and an employee assistance program.
- Professional development opportunities.

Take ownership of meaningful land development projects within a technically focused, supportive engineering consultancy.
bullets: $135K – $165K + Super - Sydney - Multidisciplinary Engineering Consultancy.
CPEng required + TUFLOW experience highly regarded.
Genuine flexibility, hybrid working and a relaxed, collaborative team culture.
candidates.content_text:
About the Company:
Representing an established multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, I am looking to introduce a Civil Engineer to a team with a strong presence across the consulting engineering and built environment sectors.
The business has built its reputation around technical capability, quality project delivery and strong working relationships. It is a practice where engineers are encouraged to contribute, take ownership of their work and collaborate directly with experienced colleagues rather than simply becoming another number in a large organisation.
The culture is down to earth, with a genuine emphasis on supporting the people around you, enjoying the work and creating an environment where good engineers can do their best work.
The Opportunity:
An opportunity is available for a Civil Engineer with a background in land development to join the Sydney team.
The preference is for a Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) who is comfortable taking technical ownership of civil design and contributing to the delivery of development projects across NSW.
You will work across the civil engineering design process, with exposure to stormwater management, drainage, earthworks and associated infrastructure. The role offers the opportunity to contribute technically, work alongside experienced engineers and have a genuine influence on project outcomes.
While CPEng accreditation is strongly preferred, the business is also open to considering experienced intermediate engineers with relevant land development experience who are progressing towards chartership and greater technical responsibility.
Experience with TUFLOW modelling would be particularly advantageous.
What You Will Be Doing:
- Undertaking civil engineering design across a range of land development projects.
- Developing civil design solutions for stormwater drainage, earthworks, roads and associated infrastructure.
- Undertaking hydraulic and hydrological modelling, including stormwater management and flood assessments.
- Preparing engineering calculations, technical reports, design documentation and supporting approval submissions.
- Coordinating with internal engineering disciplines, external consultants, clients and relevant authorities.
- Applying relevant Australian Standards, council requirements and engineering guidelines throughout the design process.
- Contributing to design reviews, technical discussions and the overall delivery of projects.
What We Are Looking For:
- A degree in Civil Engineering.
- CPEng accreditation strongly preferred, with consideration given to experienced engineers progressing towards chartership.
- A minimum of 5+ years’ experience within civil engineering consultancy, ideally with 3+ years in the land development sector.
- Sound understanding of civil design principles, stormwater management and drainage design.
- Experience using 12d and/or Civil 3D expected.
- Working knowledge of DRAINS and MUSIC is desirable.
- TUFLOW modelling experience would be highly regarded.
- The ability to work collaboratively, communicate technical information and take ownership of your work.
What's On Offer:
- $135,000 – $165,000 + Super, depending on experience and capability.
- The business offers a working environment with plenty to like:
- Flexible working: Hybrid arrangements and flexible start and finish times.
- A supportive team: Work alongside experienced engineers in an approachable, collaborative environment.
- A relaxed culture: A professional workplace without unnecessary corporate formalities.
- Team connection: Regular social activities and company events throughout the year.
- Professional development: Opportunities to broaden your technical experience and contribute to increasingly complex projects.
Importantly, flexibility is not just something written into a policy. The business is happy to have a genuine conversation about what works for you.
About Me:
I'm David Hamilton, a Registered Architect who has transitioned into specialist recruitment across the architecture, engineering and construction industries.
Having worked within the built environment myself, I understand the technical nature of these roles and appreciate that choosing the right next move is about considerably more than a job title or salary.
My approach is straightforward. I take the time to understand both the opportunity and the individual, ensuring there is a genuine alignment between the two.
Apply:
If you are a Civil Engineer with land development experience and are interested in exploring an opportunity with a technically focused, supportive and flexible consultancy, I would welcome a confidential conversation.
Click APPLY or send your CV in Word format to david@salexo.com.au.
For a confidential discussion, call me on (02) 9922 9622.
*All applications and enquiries will be treated in the strictest confidence.

About BMD
BMD is Australia's leading integrated engineering, construction and urban development business. As the largest privately owned civil contractor in Australia, BMD is at the forefront of excellence.
Over a 45-year history, BMD has grown to become a $2 billion operation, now sharing our expertise internationally in the Philippines and the UK.
About the Project
The Tram to Springvale Alliance (TSA), made up of BMD Constructions, CPB Contractors and Arup, is delivering the Eastern Freeway Upgrades between Tram and Springvale roads. The works include new express lanes, upgraded noise walls, and revitalised areas of the Koonung Creek Linear Park. The project is being delivered under an Alliance Contract with Victorian Infrastructure Delivery Authority (VIDA), forming a single, collaborative team.
As part of the North East Link Program (NELP), the upgrade will improve safety and efficiency for over 135,000 daily vehicles, remove 15,000 trucks from local roads, and reduce traffic across the Yarra River by 50,000 vehicles per day.
We’re completing the link together and bringing it home for our community.
About the Role
We are seeking motivated Civil Site Engineers who are eager to build their careers in civil construction and contribute to the successful delivery of major road and infrastructure projects.
You will have exposure across one or more of the following civil construction scopes:
- Bulk and detailed earthworks
- Drainage and utilities
- Pavements, asphalt and haulage operations
- Structural works and concrete construction
- Retaining walls and soil nail walls
- Micro-tunnelling and trenchless solutions
Your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with planning, coordination and delivery of construction activities
- Monitoring site progress, quality and safety
- Supporting cost control, procurement and subcontractor management
- Preparing documentation including ITPs, NCRs, permits and daily reports
- Working closely with supervisors and project engineers to ensure successful project outcomes
About You
We’d love to hear from you if you have:
- A degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline
- 1–5 years’ experience in civil infrastructure or construction
- Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills
- A proactive approach, willingness to learn and positive attitude onsite
- A commitment to working safely and contributing to a supportive team environment
What We Offer
- Be part of a nationally respected contractor with a strong local presence
- Benefit from job security, competitive salary, and long-term project pipeline
- Clear career progression and ongoing professional development
- Collaborate with top-tier delivery partners in a high-impact alliance
- Contribute to a legacy project shaping Melbourne’s future
- Be recognised at our annual employee awards event and through our Thrive reward and recognition platform
- Access wellness programs, strong work-life balance initiatives, paid parental leave, retail discounts, industry training and memberships & more
Ready to build your future with BMD?
Apply now and take the next step in your engineering career by contributing to one of Victoria’s largest and most significant infrastructure projects.
We recognise that we are strengthened by diversity, and we embrace differences as an equal opportunity employer providing a flexible and inclusive workplace.
For further details on what makes BMD unique, head to https://www.bmdgroup.global

About Brisbane Civil
Brisbane Civil is a Southeast Queensland based civil contractor with a head office on Loganholme. Part of Doughty Group deliver civil works across a variety of sectors, from Department of Transport and Local Government through to commercial, industrial and residential subdivision projects. Our pipeline is strong, and our Estimating Department is growing with it.
Why you'll love it here
- Pure tendering. Price, win, handover repeat.
- A team behind you. Work alongside fellow estimators who share the load and back each other.
- A dedicated BDM. Partner with our Business Development Manager on new opportunities and long-repeat standing clients.
- Real variety. Tendering across multiple sectors ensuring no day is the same.

- Room to grow. Competitive package including vehicle / allowance, phone, laptop and career pathways across the Doughty Group.

- Developing methodologies, programs and staging with our construction and project teams

- Preparing budget estimates and cost plans for clients and developers
- Steering post-tender negotiations through to award, then handing over cleanly to the delivery team
What you'll bring
- 8+ years' civil estimating experience with a civil contractor
- Highly regarded: a background with an SEQ civil contractor delivering similar work. You'll know the market, the clients and how the work gets built
- Estimating experience in one or more of TMR, residential, industrial, commercial or Local Government (multi-sector is a big plus)
- Experience with Expert, our estimating system, is highly regarded. Similar software is fine if you can pick Expert up quickly
- Working knowledge of TMR MRTS, IPWEAQ and the SEQ Water Supply & Sewerage Code
- A sharp eye for detail and the ability to juggle multiple tenders against tight deadlines
- Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or Quantity Surveying (preferred)
- Current White Card and Drivers Licence
Ready for your next move?
Hit Apply and send us your resume. Want a confidential chat first? Call Jasmine on 0428 275 916.
All enquiries are treated in strict confidence.
We'll be shortlisting as applications are received, so don't wait to apply.

candidates.content_text:
Build your career on a Tier 1 Defence project delivering major road and civil infrastructure works at RAAF Base Wagga.
The Riverina Redevelopment Joint Venture (RRJV) is a 50/50 joint venture between CPB Contractors and Downer to undertake major upgrades and replacement of existing infrastructure and facilities to support Defence capability for the next 30 years.
The proposed project consists of a program of works across three Department of Defence establishments including:
- Albury Wodonga Military Area (including North, South & East Bandiana, Latchford Barracks, Wirlinga)
- Blamey Barracks (Kapooka)
- RAAF Base Wagga
The proposed capital investment of $2 billion will incorporate a variety of elements including:
- Construction of new messing and living in accommodation
- Construction of new training facilities
- Refurbishment and upgrading of existing buildings
- Remedial works and upgrades to infrastructure services
To review all Downer opportunities on the Riverina Deployment Joint Venture (RRJV) please visit the website: Downer in the NSW Riverina - Downer Group Australia
The opportunity
We have an opportunity for a Project Engineer - Infrastructure with proven road infrastructure experience to join the Riverina Redevelopment Program at RAAF Base Wagga. Working within a Tier 1 Joint Venture Environment, you'll support the planning and delivery of road and civil works, including earthworks, drainage and pavements, while coordinating subcontractors and work packages to achieve safe, high-quality and cost-effective outcomes.
What you'll do
- Support the planning and delivery of road and civil infrastructure works, including earthworks, drainage and pavements.
- Manage and coordinate construction work packages from planning through to completion
- Oversee subcontractor performance, ensuring safety, quality, programme and cost targets are met
- Support project planning, risk identification, constructability reviews and contract administration
- Monitor project budgets, cost forecasts, variations, claims and progress reporting
- Ensure compliance with HSEQ requirements, project management plans and HOTO obligations
What you'll bring
- Degree qualification in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
- 6-8 years' Project Engineering experience, with demonstrated experience delivering road infrastructure projectsincluding earthworks, drainage, pavements and associated civil works.
- Strong understanding of cost control, forecasting, contract administration and project reporting.
- Proven ability to build effective working relationships with clients, subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
- A proactive, safety-focused approach with a strong commitment to quality, delivery and continuous improvement.
RRJV is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are strongly encouraged to apply.
This is an on-site position based in Wagga Wagga, NSW. While DIDO and FIFO arrangements are not available, relocation assistance is offered. Applicants must be Australian citizens and willing to obtain an AGSVA security clearance.
Spotless Management Services Pty Ltd (a Downer Company) is delivering the works as part of a joint venture with CPB Contractors Pty Ltd. Accordingly we will share your Personal Information, to the extent necessary, for the purpose of recruitment for the joint venture with CPB Contractors Pty Ltd who are required to handle that information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). 
Why Downer?
At Downer, we plan, create, and sustain essential public services across Australia and New Zealand. From hospitals to data centres and defence partnerships, we manage critical infrastructure that keeps communities thriving.
What It Means to Belong at Downer
We're proud of our high-performance culture and commitment to diversity, offering:
- Training and development to support and diversify your career.
- With 30% of vacancies filled internally you'll find real opportunities to advance your career.
- Perks@Downer: healthcare discounts, great savings on retail purchases, car purchases and much more.
- Employee Assistance Program: professional support for you and your family when you need it most.
You want your work to matter and so do we. With over 26,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific, our team is made up of individuals with unique perspectives, backgrounds, and ideas.
We know that diversity makes us stronger and we actively celebrate it through our commitment to inclusion and belonging.
We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and we welcome people of all ages, genders, sexual orientations, cultures, abilities, and lived experiences. We especially encourage applications from those whose voices have traditionally been underrepresented in our industry, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, Māori and Pasifika Peoples, veterans, people with disability, and neurodivergent individuals. Even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with this role, we'd still like to hear from you. If it feels like the right fit, apply - potential counts, and so do you.
As a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, we support flexibility that works for your life, inclusive leadership that values your voice, and equitable access to opportunity so you can do your best work and bring your whole self to it.
If you need support or adjustments through the recruitment process, just let us know, we're here to help you put your best foot forward.

Ready for your next move? 
Join STP Consultants as a Civil Engineer and become part of our growing Brisbane team, delivering a diverse range of projects across Queensland. You'll work on challenging engineering solutions, take ownership of your work and collaborate with experienced professionals across a multidisciplinary consultancy.
This is an opportunity to broaden your technical experience, contribute to meaningful projects and play an important role in the continued development of our Brisbane office.
Why you’ll love working here 
A growing team with exciting opportunities
Be part of a supportive team where your experience, ideas and contribution are valued. As our Brisbane office expands, you'll have the opportunity to build strong professional relationships, share your knowledge and make a meaningful contribution to our continued success.
Variety that builds your experience
Work across residential, commercial and infrastructure projects, gaining exposure to a range of engineering challenges across Queensland. From developing technical solutions to supporting project delivery, you'll have the opportunity to apply your skills across diverse projects and continue expanding your experience.
Take ownership of your career
Develop your technical capabilities, take on greater responsibility and learn from experienced engineers and designers. Depending on your experience and interests, you'll have opportunities to lead projects, mentor developing professionals and strengthen your client relationships.
A great Brisbane location
Our Fortitude Valley office is conveniently located close to public transport, cafés and restaurants, with easy access to the CBD, New Farm and Howard Smith Wharves. Enjoy a convenient work location while being part of a team delivering quality engineering solutions.
What's in it for you? 
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and the value you bring. 
- 
Flexibility: 9-day fortnight, flexible hours, plus the option to purchase additional leave. 
- 
Professional development: CPD support, mentoring and opportunities to build your technical expertise.
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs that celebrate your contribution.
- 
Inclusive, friendly culture: Supportive colleagues, collaborative working relationships and regular social events. 
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
- 
Career growth: Opportunities to take ownership of your work, develop your skills and progress within STP.
- 
Stability & reputation: Join a respected, Australian-owned consultancy with a strong and diverse client base. 
The opportunity 
As our Brisbane office continues to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Civil Engineer to join our team and help deliver exciting projects across Queensland. 
In this role, you will:
- Deliver civil engineering projects from concept and feasibility through to design and construction 
- Undertake technical and feasibility studies, including site investigations and assessments 
- Prepare detailed civil designs and engineering reports for industrial, commercial and land development projects 
- Design roads, drainage, earthworks and flexible and rigid pavements 
- Develop stormwater management solutions, including flood modelling and civil DA documentation 
- Prepare tender, design and construction documentation 
- Conduct civil site inspections and provide construction support to ensure quality project outcomes 
- Collaborate with clients, consultants and multidisciplinary teams to coordinate and resolve design solutions 
- Assist with project planning, budgets, quality assurance and delivery 
- Build strong client relationships and contribute to successful project outcomes 
- Support and share knowledge with junior engineers and designers 
- Contribute to the continued growth of our Brisbane team 
About you
- Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or equivalent. 
- Minimum 5 years' experience in a similar role, preferable within a consulting environment 
- Experience with 12D, AutoCAD, DRAINS, MUSIC or XPStorm will be highly regarded 
- Strong knowledge of Australian Standards, planning frameworks, engineering codes and local authority requirements 
- Strong stormwater, flood modelling and pavement design knowledge  
- RPEQ registration (or ability to gain) is highly desirable. 
- Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team. 
- Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency 
About STP Consultants
